title: Release train - weekly prep (go/no-go checklist)
content:
Objective: Prep notes for weekly release train sync (Thu 2026-05-01 09:30 PT). Goal is to confirm go/no-go for 2026-05-07 minor launch and surface any last-minute risks or owners for mitigations.

Quick summary: current stage = candidate build deployed to canary; smoke tests mostly passing, one flaky e2e on macOS agent; DB migration script (optimize_embeddings_v2) scheduled tomorrow night; docs and support playbook mostly ready but still need sign-off from CS.

Agenda for sync (15-20m):
- Quick status (owners) - 3m
- Go/no-go criteria review - 5m
- Open blockers & mitigations (owners, ETA) - 7m
- Rollback/contingency confirm + comms plan - 3m

Go / No-go criteria (must all be YES for green):
- [OK] Candidate deployed to canary (commit: 9f3a2b) - owner: Arjun Mehta
- [OK] Critical smoke tests passing on linux and linux-gpu infra - owner: QA (Maya Singh)
- [ISSUE] Flaky e2e on macOS agent (test: chat-history-flows) - owner: QA (Maya) - flaky failure rate ~1/8, root cause investigation in progress (possible timing). Mitigation: skip macOS E2E for canary run OR increase wait timeout; target fix by 2026-05-01 18:00 PT.
- [OK] DB migration dry-run completed on staging - owner: Platform Eng (Liam O'Connor)
- [PENDING] Production DB migration window confirmed with SRE (approved timeslot 02:00-03:00 PT) - owner: SRE (Liam) - awaiting final runbook sign-off
- [OK] Model artifact (quantized v1.3) validated on dedicated infra - owner: Serving Runtime (Zara Ali)
- [OK] Observability dashboards updated + alert thresholds set - owner: Observability (Arjun Mehta)
- [PENDING] Support playbook & rollout messaging approved by CS - owner: Customer Success (Maya / CS lead) - CS to confirm by EOD 2026-05-01
- [OK] Rollback plan documented and smoke-tested - owner: Release Management (Carmen)
- [OK] Release notes + changelog drafted and reviewed - owner: Product (Arjun)

Release checklist (owners + quick status):
- Pre-release: finalize release artifacts (sha, tag) - Carmen - DONE
- Pre-release: cut RC tag and push artifacts to registry - Arjun - DONE (tag v1.3.2-rc)
- Pre-release: ensure infra autoscaling policy includes burst capacity - Platform Eng (Liam) - IN PROGRESS (ETA 5/1 14:00 PT)
- Pre-release: security scan (SCA + dependency checks) - Security (TBD) - PASSED
- Pre-release: kyverno policy check for manifests - Infra (Nadia) - PASSED
- Pre-release: docs & release notes - Product (Arjun) - REVIEWED
- Release window: schedule DB migration, drain nodes plan - SRE (Liam) - PENDING FINAL SIGN-OFF
- Post-release: verification run (smoke, perf 95pct latency) - QA (Maya) - SCHEDULED
- Post-release: update dashboards and cost monitors - Observability (Arjun) - READY
- Post-release: customer comms sent (internal + external) - CS (Maya) & Marketing - DRAFTED

Open blockers / escalations (with proposed mitigations):
1) macOS e2e flaky (chat-history-flows) - severity: medium (blocks full E2E green).
   - Proposed: allow canary to proceed if only macOS e2e failing and failure rate under 15%; ship with increased client-side retry; track incident post-release. Owner: Maya.
2) DB migration runbook sign-off - severity: high (blocks safe migration).
   - Proposed: SRE to do 1st migration in staging during off-hours with platform eng on-call; set guardrail to abort on >1% slow queries. Owner: Liam.
3) Autoscaling burst not fully validated on prod-like load - severity: medium.
   - Proposed: run short load test against dedicated pool tonight (2026-05-01 22:00 PT). Owner: Liam / Platform Eng.
4) Support playbook missing steps for rollback scenario - severity: low/medium.
   - Proposed: CS to add step-by-step rollback script + canned customer email templates by EOD. Owner: Maya.

Contingency & rollback plan (short):
- If critical perf regressions or error surge (>5% 5xx over 10m) after release: trigger automatic traffic ramp down to stable model variant + open incident (severity 1) and roll back to previous tag (v1.3.1).
- DB migration: if any long-running locks or replication lag > 2min, abort migration and failover read traffic to replicas.
- Communication: incident channel = #release-train (Slack); paging for SRE on-call.

Communications plan & timeline:
- 2026-05-06 18:00 PT - internal ops dry-run (only oncall + leads)
- 2026-05-06 22:00 PT - final human review and support playbook sign-off cutover
- 2026-05-07 02:00-03:00 PT - deployment + DB migration window
- 2026-05-07 03:15 PT - post-deploy smoke & perf checks
- 2026-05-07 04:00 PT - if green, publish external release notes and customer email

Notes to self / questions to raise during sync:
- Confirm SRE lead for the migration window (ping Liam)
- Make sure Marketing has the short blurb for customers with bullet points on changes to latency/cost expectations
- Verify who will own the first 2 hours of paging post-release (SRE on-call + Arjun product lead)

Action items (owner, due):
- Maya: finish flaky e2e investigation + temporary skip rule if needed - due 2026-05-01 18:00 PT
- Liam: final runbook + validate autoscale burst (load test tonight) - due 2026-05-01 23:59 PT
- Arjun: push final RC artifacts and confirm observability alerts - due 2026-05-01 17:00 PT
- Carmen: finalize rollback script and publish to Confluence - due 2026-05-01 20:00 PT
- CS Lead (Maya): sign off support playbook + customer comms - due 2026-05-01 EOD

Questions for the release meeting (explicit):
- Do we accept proceeding with canary green if only macOS E2E failing at low rate? (need vote)
- Is the DB migration window locked in and runbook approved?
- Are we comfortable with the autoscaling burst test results tonight?

Misc notes / links:
- Canary commit: 9f3a2b - tag v1.3.2-rc
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1423
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Release+Train+May+2026
- Jira: REL-210 (release checklist), ENG-4321 (optimize embeddings migration)

End of prep notes. Will update after Thursday sync with final go/no-go decision and any changes to owners.

-- Carmen
